pictures.scene: Lucas van Valckenborch, Bergachtig landschap - the great sunlit rock mass with the blue stone tower and the domed church standing on the wooded height above the ravine and the tiny figures climbing below, a song of ascents of David
pictures.name: pd_valckenborch_opgang

pictures.scene: Giovanni Maria Bottala, Meeting between Esau and Jacob - the two brothers embracing cheek to cheek with Esau's arm round Jacob's shoulder and the kneeling boy reaching up to them between the camels and the horse, behold how good and pleasant it is when brothers live together in harmony
pictures.name: pd_bottala_broeders

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, Man in oosterse kleding - the grey bearded man in his white turban with the gold jewelled band, his beard running down over the gold embroidered robe and the white fur collar, it is like fine oil on the head running down on the beard, running down Aaron's beard over the collar of his robes
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_kraag

pictures.scene: Achille Etna Michallon, Goatherd Opposite the Falls of Tivoli - the waterfalls streaming down the dark green mountainside under the hilltop town with its white tower and the goatherd in his red cloak on the rocks below, it is like the dew of Hermon
pictures.name: pd_michallon_dauw

pictures.scene: Johann Wilhelm Schirmer, The Wetterhorn - the sunlit rock peak high above its snowfields and glaciers with the crescent moon in the blue sky and the white torrent running down over the rocks through the dark pine forest below, falling on the mountains of Zion
pictures.name: pd_schirmer_hermon

pictures.scene: Hendrik Voogd, Italiaans landschap met parasoldennen - the tall umbrella pines against a luminous pale gold evening sky over bright sunlit grass with the long shadows and the figures resting on it, for there the LORD has bestowed the blessing
pictures.name: pd_voogd_leven

pictures.scene: Pieter van Laer, De wijnoogst - the whole company gathered under the great tree at the vintage with the woman carrying her basket of grapes, the laden pack horse and the man kneeling to the full basket, and the church tower standing in the haze behind them, of life forevermore
pictures.name: pd_laer_zegen

lines.text: A song of ascents. Of David.
Behold, how good and pleasant it is
when brothers live together in harmony!
It is like fine oil on the head,
over the collar of his robes.
It is like the dew of Hermon
falling on the mountains of Zion.
For there the LORD has bestowed the blessing
